intent: B1-X5 Combat Test Harness telemetry minimal contract. Every in-game scenario run MUST emit a telemetry JSON conforming to this schema; the host driver validates it before evaluating asserts. Optional sections are emitted when the in-game capability exists; missing optional sections are recorded as not_measured, never as PASS/FAIL. This contract is the only interface between the in-game fixture (k5-combat-harness MOD / ScenarioDirector.gd) and the host driver (scripts/validate/combat_harness.py).

scenario_id.description: Scenario id from combat_scenarios.json; must equal the requested scenario id.

seed.description: Explicit seed used for the in-game RNG (Godot seed()). Must equal the requested seed.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC start timestamp (in-game wall clock, OS.get_unix_time or similar).

ok.description: True when the game window became visible and no fatal/ALERT occurred.

fatal_count.description: Count of captured fatal markers during the run.

alert_count.description: Count of captured ALERT dialogs/log markers during the run.

alive.description: Mobs still alive at run end.

killed.description: Mobs that reached their death settlement.

duplicate_deaths.description: Second+ death settlement attempts on the same mob (must be 0 when death settles once).

damage_events.description: Direct damage events observed (mob health loss events).

screenshots.description: Absolute or repo-relative screenshot paths captured during the run.

in_game_result.description: In-game self classification; the host driver re-evaluates asserts independently and its verdict is authoritative.

proves.description: Free-form: what the in-game run claims to prove.

not_proven.description: Free-form: what the in-game run does not claim to prove.
